briefdescription.para: CSI (Control Sequence Introducer) sequence dispatch, cursor, scroll, and report handlers.

detaileddescription.para: This translation unit implements Video::applyCSI() and the cursor, scroll, and report CSI handler functions. Mode handlers live in VideoMode.cpp. A CSI sequence has the form:
where <params> is a semicolon-separated list of decimal integers, <intermediates> is zero or more bytes in 0x20-0x2F, and <final> is a single byte in 0x40–0x7E that identifies the command.

simplesect.title: Dispatch table
simplesect.para: applyCSI() switches on the final byte and delegates to a dedicated handler for each recognised sequence. Private sequences (those with ? as the first intermediate byte) are routed to handlePrivateMode() for DECSET/DECRST processing.

simplesect.title: Thread model
simplesect.para: All functions in this file run exclusively on the READER THREAD.
Video.h — class declaration and full API documentation
Video.cpp — ground-state print and applyControlCode handlers
VideoMode.cpp — DEC private mode and ANSI mode handlers
CSI — parameter accumulator passed to every handler
